purpose: Isolated native experiment for moving partial's existing size rejection earlier.

shared_benchmark_home.proof: All131 consumed input hashes match except the frozen compiler optimizations.py patch. Build uses candidate home; benchmark native/hosted emission, profile and timing use current home for identical library/runtime filenames. Hosted compiler imports remain from its own checkout cwd. No output normalization.

method: One CPython-hosted experimental native build, not a fixed-point bootstrap. Six exact-output probe comparisons, one matched whole-process Callgrind IR-emission observation and six preplanned alternating native IR-emission pairs. This does not measure full JIT startup or rerun kernel timings.

attribution.method: Self costs sum exactly to whole-process summary. Function inclusive cost is self plus recorded outgoing call-edge costs; nested inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed. Inlined instructions are charged to their containing emitted function, so absence of a source helper symbol does not prove zero work.
